chapter.heading: Psalm 49
Why Should I Fear in Times of Trouble?
To the choirmaster. A Psalm of the Sons of Korah.
chapter.v: Give ear , all inhabitants of the world ,
rich and poor together !
the meditation of my heart shall be understanding .
I will solve myriddle to the music of the lyre .
when the iniquity of those who cheat me surrounds me ,
and boast of the abundance of their riches ?
orgive to Godthe price of his life ,
and can never suffice ,
andnever see the pit .
andleave their wealth to others .
though theycalled lands by their own names .
he is like the beasts that perish .
yet after them people approve of their boasts . Selah
Their form shall be consumedin Sheol , with no place to dwell .
for he willreceive me . Selah
when the glory of his house increases .
his glory will not go down after him .
and though you get praise when you do well for yourself —
who will never againsee light .
Man in his pomp yet without understanding is like the beasts that perish .
